blurb: Idaho Helicopters offers a range of helicopter services including charter flights for recreational and professional purposes, light construction and reclamation projects, firefighting support, air ambulance operations, and helicopter maintenance. They operate a modern fleet and are a Bell Customer Service Facility and FAA Part 145 repair station. Their services have been operating since 1970.
